2025-05-01.name: Kun Tun Tianxia Zhi Zhang Men Guilai
2025-05-01.desc:
Fan Lingxiao, a gifted spirit pet master, was ambushed in the A-level sect promotion competition and devoured by his own spirit pet whale, Kun. When he woke up, he found himself reincarnated into a young man named "Liu Fengmang" who is imprisoned in the White Mansion.

His sect, Lingxiao Pavilion, was also in dire straits. In order to find out the truth about the backlash of the spirit Kun and revive his sect, Fan Lingxiao takes his existing spirit pets and embarks on a new adventure with Gu Ling, Cheng Xi, and Yue Tong.

source: MAL

2025-05-09.name: Gekijouban Uta no Prince-sama: Taboo Night Kisses

2025-05-13.name: Da Xia Qing Shang Gong
2025-05-13.desc:
Fifty years ago, the martial arts world was suddenly invaded by "chaos." Murong Qiong formed a demon sect to fight against it, but they could not win despite the hard battle. The messenger of God Yi Zhihua came and taught everyone the demonization skills to successfully defeat the chaos. But the messenger of God left, and the demonization skills were introduced into the martial arts world and got out of control. Murong Qiong was disappointed and retired. His subordinate Yu Huabing took the opportunity to take over, improved the demonization skills, and created the punk invigoration era, making the martial arts world prosperous, but the price was that the martial artists all became "superior martial arts monsters." Dongfang Sheng, a young man with a pure heart, found Murong Qiong who had retired to the Xiangxi Hotel, hoping to rely on him to restore the former glory of the martial arts world. Thus this ridiculous story begins...

source: MAL

2025-05-18.name: Bulgeun Yeou
2025-05-18.desc:
Welcome to Ibana, a beautiful country also known as the red country. Here, lives the red fox, a wily beast who takes on the form of a human and feasts on the livers of humans. For hundreds of years, the fox kills without hesitation until, thanks to one human woman, it comes to know what that human emotion called "love", truly is. Out of the land of fire, erupts the cruel yet tragic love story of one evil spirit who yearns to possess the heart of one human woman.

source: ANN

note: The first episode was aired on youtube one day before the official Laftel release on 19.05.2025.

2025-05-19.name: Tun Tian Ji
2025-05-19.desc:
Tun Tian Ji depicts the legendary transformation of the young Wu Yu from a mortal to an immortal Buddha.

source: MAL

2025-05-23.desc: * Based on an adventure novel by Hayamine Kaoru.

2025-05-23.name: Ling Long 2
2025-05-23.desc:
In this thrilling continuation, former Wilderness Hunter Commander Mark has transformed into a blood-stained monster who destroys lighthouses. Guided by the enigmatic Bai Yue Kui, he embarks on a new mission. The arrival of survivors on the ground reveals that the lighthouse isn't humanity's final refuge. Facing adversity, they harness their innate abilities to combat the Mana ecosystem. Bai Yue Kui's past intricately links to Mark's origins and the apocalypse's truth.
Meanwhile, the colossal brain on the lighthouse awakens, the old shadows linger, and a new crisis emerges. As unprecedented disasters loom, where will the two human factions ultimately head? Join us for an epic journey filled with mystery, action, and deep exploration of human resilience.

source: Bilibili youtube

2025-05-28.name: Jun You Yun II
2025-05-28.desc:
Xie Kanhua is about to be executed by Shanglin Palace. During the rescue by Su Baiyi and his team, Shanglin Palace disintegrates and Su Baiyi is taken away by Su Jian, the demon king who has been trapped in the prison for 20 years. The Heroes Conference of Xuanwei City is held again. Bai Jile uses the "Heaven and Earth Sorrow" mask to lure the second best master Xue Shenguan to go there, and the martial arts world is in chaos. In order to save the injured Nangong Xier, Su Baiyi and Su Jian go to Bei Kunlun to meet Su Suomo, the ancestor of the Su family. Xie Yuling and Feng Zuojun go to Qingcheng Mountain and Demon City to learn martial arts. In the undercurrent, Yingzhou Fairy Island reappears, and the visitors from Yingzhou provoke the martial arts people. Those who obey will prosper, and those who resist will perish...

source: movie.douban.com/googletranslate

2025-05-30.name: Gekijouban Soushuuhen Jujutsu Kaisen: Kaigyoku / Gyokusetsu
2025-05-30.desc: * Based on a dark fantasy shounen manga by Akutami Gege.

2025-05-30.name: I Byeol-e Pil-yohan
2025-05-30.desc:
Nan-young is a scientist, whose astronaut mom failed to return to Earth when things went awry during her Mars probe. Nan-young has always dreamed of exploring space too, and longs to go to Mars in hopes of finding a trace of her mom. Her dream comes true when she is selected as one of the astronauts for a Mars probe project. Before she blasts off though, she meets Jay, a musician who also fixes retro sound instruments. (It's all thanks to an old turntable that Nan-young inherited from her mom.)

Source: Netflix

2025-05-30.name: Wiheomhan Pyeonuijeom
2025-05-30.desc:
College student Yeo Eui-joon works the graveyard shift at a convenience store to pay his bills. The shift sucks, but the money's good, and the customers--mostly mobsters and hoodlums--don't cause too much trouble. That might be due to Gunwoo, a tall, hunky gangster who frequents the store for booze and cigarettes. He's scarier than the rest of the clientele, but seems to have a soft spot for Eui-joon, defending him from the more volatile customers. Could there be more behind Gunwoo's protective actions? And if so, is Eui-joon prepared to be a part of Gunwoo's violent world?

source: books.google

2025-05-30.name: Xian Ni: Shenlin Zhi Zhan
2025-05-30.desc:
Behind the Ancient God's Land, the Eternal Night Demon City in the Demon Cultivation Sea rose up overnight. In order to expand its territory, it constantly attacked the sects around the Demon Cultivation Sea, including the Yuntian Sect where Li Muwan was. Li Muwan was poisoned in the battle to protect the gate, and her life was at stake. After Wang Lin learned about this, he took her into the Demon Cultivation Sea again. Wang Lin fought against the three city lords with his initial cultivation of the God of Incarnation, and became famous in the Demon Cultivation Sea. He brought back the antidote to save Li Muwan, but found that the crisis was not resolved, and the thousand-year conspiracy surfaced. In the end, relying on their feelings and the first fusion with the body of the Ancient God after the God of Incarnation, they joined forces to kill the Demon Lord.

source: bgm.tv/googletranslate

2025-05-31.desc: Second season of Wangzhe Rongyao: Rongyao Zhi Zhang.
